method: Direct inspection of six timestamp-matched reference/commanded/measured RGB thumbnails; unblinded qualitative assessment, not full-video review.
observations: The tall hotel tower, lower entrance canopy, landscaped bushes, trees and stone sign remain recognizable in both generated arms at the sampled timestamps.

The displayed commanded and measured samples appear identical, consistent with all three proposed memory writes being rejected. Full RGB equality is separately tested by the scorer and the all-frame audit.
Both generated arms show a contrast/saturation change between frames 84 and 85, with the building retained. Later samples differ from the reference in foliage, sign and entrance detail.

Position is unavailable in both arms because VIPE anchor depth does not support a scalar gauge conversion. Mean rotation is 0.598354 degrees and endpoint rotation 0.868690 degrees in the canonical evaluation of identical inputs.
No near-total scene loss is visible in these samples. This is abstention, not active correction benefit or evidence of physical motion accuracy.
classification: Exact-output abstention with unavailable position registration; recognizable hotel with appearance/layout drift.
temporal_limitation: Six static timestamps do not establish full-video quality, smoothness, physical motion direction, or absence of between-sample failures.
